about: What server/maps-render.mjs expects of the Ithomiini Maps app's export interface (DESIGN.md 2.2-2.3, 3.4 with the round 2 addendum), as implemented by the app (ithomiini_maps-uioverhaul docs/field-sites.md). Picture geometry (view.overlays, records[].x/y/in_picture, sites[].x/y/radius/label_boxes/occluded) is required: an answer without it falls back (geometry_missing).

never: any size, DPI, format, title or script parameter
url_params.bbox: w,s,e,n in degrees, 5 decimals; read once; fitBounds after the export frame has its size; frames only, never filters; suppresses the app's own auto-fit to data

call: await window.ithomiiniMapsExport()  (no arguments; the only code the worker evaluates)

fit.await: map idle after the fit, before capture
fit.note: db-side assumption: the app uses exactly this padding and max zoom for bbox= and reports them in view.fit

result.png_base64: string: the Export Image button's PNG, 1600 x 1200

params.applied: object: what the app honoured from the URL
params.ignored: array of parameter names; must be empty

result.basemap: the MAP_STYLES key in effect; must equal style=
result.title: string composed by the app from its filters, e.g. 'Tithorea harmonia · females · Ecuador'
result.title_truncated: boolean: the title strip cut the title short (the tool then does not quote it)

view.bbox: [w, s, e, n]: map.getBounds() of that view (the frame's visible bounds)
view.frame: { width, height }: the map's CSS size used by fitBounds (db-side assumption: map.getContainer().clientWidth/clientHeight); 760 x 570 within 8 px
view.overlays: [{ kind: 'title'|'legend'|'scale'|'attribution', x, y, width, height }]: boxes drawn over the map in the picture, CSS px of the 760 x 570 canvas (top left 0, 0)
view.legend_placement: { corner, placements_tried, occluded_sites, occluded_records }: the legend corner the app kept (it tries the bottom corners when the legend covers a marker); informational

result.records: [{ source (as in the data files, e.g. 'Sanger Institute'), id, sex (map-native or null), country, year (integer or null, from observation_date), date, subspecies, lng, lat, x, y, in_picture }]: the whole filtered set, not only the frame. x, y: the recorded lng/lat projected (never a display offset); in_picture: in the frame, outside every overlay, and in a drawn marker that is not occluded

legend.rows: [{ label, records, unknown (true for the 'Unknown subspecies' row) }]: rows add up to records.length

result.sites: [{ marker, lng, lat, center_in_view, records, label (first label clear of overlays, or null), labels, merged_sites, members: [{ key, locality, record_ids: ['source|id'] }], x, y, radius (the marker as drawn, CSS px), label_boxes: [{ x, y, width, height }], hidden_labels, occluded (disc or a label box touches an overlay), occluded_by: [kinds] }]: the markers drawn in the frame
result.capture_attempts: 1, or 2 when the state changed during the first capture and it was taken again (a second change rejects)

checks_in_db: params.ignored empty; basemap and color_by as asked
view: centre within 1e-5 deg and zoom within 0.02 of fitBounds(bbox, view.frame, padding 32, maxZoom 12); view.bbox consistent with centre/zoom/frame within 1e-4; view.bbox contains bbox
parity: source|id sets equal (explicit bbox: app records inside the requested bbox); sex, country, year equal; lng/lat equal after rounding to 1e-5
legend unit records, sum = app records (whole set)

picture geometry: overlays well formed (title when there is a title, legend when it has rows); records' and markers' x/y = our own projection of lng/lat within 1 px; in_picture and occluded exactly as defined above; labels exactly the label boxes inside the frame and clear of overlays (else geometry_missing / geometry_invalid / geometry_inconsistent)
every ranked tool site inside view.bbox: its records inside view.bbox are all members of drawn markers
a site the answer names (best sites) in an occluded marker: ranked_site_hidden (Pillow); another one is left out of picture_labels and listed in hidden_sites
visible records (records.on_picture, caption) = records with in_picture; with an explicit bbox the caption gives the area's visible records and the others visible around it separately
luminance SD > 8; no outer-4-px row or column with more than 25% accent pixels

example.about: A complete answer (PNG left out) for an auto frame: Tena and Loreto are the sites the tool names (expect.required); Anangu is inside the view but 12 px from the top, under the title strip, so it is occluded, its record is not in_picture, and checkExport leaves it out (hidden_sites) instead of claiming it.
